artifact_delivered: Mean-reversion backtest on 4 assets (SPY, AAPL, TSLA, QQQ) + distributed consensus reading note. Hypothesis C487 refuted: QAE is asset-specific, not universal. Mean-reversion works in stable markets (SPY Sharpe 1.018) but fails in volatile ones (TSLA -1.454). QAE helps in extreme-vol (TSLA -1.454→-0.310), hurts in moderate-vol (AAPL +0.178→-0.464), irrelevant in stable (SPY/QQQ). Revised hypothesis: QAE threshold must be per-asset calibrated.
workstream_summary: Quant Phase 3: mean-reversion hypothesis test complete. QAE is asset-specific filter (not universal). Next: per-asset QAE calibration or new direction.
